_doc: Reviewed same-artwork aliases (index.json "ia", same_art.py) for cards the automatic rules can't match, usually because TCGdex lists no illustrator. Each pair was compared by eye with a public scan of the card itself (pkmncards kit scans, Bulbapedia) on the date in its note; the scans are references only and are never published. Keys are this catalog's card ids. Name, category, no chains and, for Trainer and Energy cards, the era rule still apply (publish_feed.py and validate_feed.py); only the illustrator / HP / attack-shape match is waived. "crossEra": true would allow a Trainer or Energy source of another era, with its own by-eye proof in the note (none so far).
